'''Farrukh Mukhamedov''' is an Uzbek mathematician<ref name="TWAS">{{cite web
 |title=Mukhamedov Farrukh
 |url=https://twas.org/directory/mukhamedov-farrukh
 |website=The World Academy of Sciences
 |publisher=TWAS
 |access-date=1 June 2026
}}</ref><ref name="UAEU">{{cite web
 |title=Farrukh Mukhamedov
 |url=https://research.uaeu.ac.ae/en/persons/farrukh-mukhamedov/
 |website=United Arab Emirates University
 |access-date=1 June 2026
}}</ref> and professor in the Department of Mathematical Sciences at [[United Arab Emirates University]].<ref name="UAEU" />

In 2005, he received [[The World Academy of Sciences]] (TWAS) prize for Young Scientists, and in 2022, he was elected a fellow member of TWAS in the mathematical sciences section<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Farrukh Mukhamedov-CORE Academy |url=https://coreacad.org/Member.aspx?ProId=112 |access-date=2026-06-08 |website=coreacad.org}}</ref> and is a corresponding fellow of [[International Core Academy of Sciences and Humanities]].<ref name=":0" />

== Education ==
Mukhamedov obtained an MSc in pure mathematics with distinction from the [[National University of Uzbekistan]] and completed his PhD in 1998.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Farrukh Mukhamedov - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=138206 |access-date= |website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref>

In 2005, he defended a [[Doctor of Science|DSc]] (Habilitation) degree, at the National University of Uzbekistan.<ref name=":0" />

== Academic career ==
Mukhamedov worked as a graduate student at the Institute of Mathematics of the Academy of Sciences of Uzbekistan,<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Mukhamedov, Farrukh Maksutovich |url=https://www.mathnet.ru/eng/person8651}}</ref> a junior scientific fellow at the same institute, a postdoctoral researcher at the [[National University of Uzbekistan]], an associate professor there, and a senior scientific fellow.<ref name=":2" />

In 2005, Mukhamedov held a postdoctoral position at the [[University of Aveiro]] in Portugal.<ref name=":0" /><ref name="Aveiro">{{cite web
 |title=F. Mukhamedov
 |url=https://sweet.ua.pt/jfmendes/grupoteorico/farrukh.htm
 |website=Group of Theoretical Physics, University of Aveiro
 |publisher=University of Aveiro
 |access-date=19 June 2026
}}</ref> He subsequently joined the Faculty of Science at [[International Islamic University Malaysia]], where he was promoted from associate professor to professor.<ref name=":0" /> From 2009 to 2015, Mukhamedov was a Junior Associate of the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] (ICTP).<ref name=":0" /> In 2016, he joined the Department of Mathematical Sciences at the [[United Arab Emirates University]] as a professor.<ref name=":0" />

== Research ==
Mukhamedov's research has contributed to several areas of pure mathematics, including quantum probability, [[ergodic theory]], dynamical systems, and [[p-adic analysis]]. In quantum probability, he applied methods from [[statistical mechanics]] to establish the existence of [[phase transitions]] in [[Quantum Markov chain|quantum Markov chains]] and disproved a conjecture concerning the occurrence of type III₁ factors in systems with non-trivial Hamiltonian interactions. He developed the theory of quantum quadratic operators and related stochastic processes. In p-adic mathematics, Mukhamedov established results in p-adic statistical mechanics, including the study of phase transitions, and contributed to the development of p-adic dynamical systems by proving the existence of chaotic behavior in p-adic [[Potts model|Potts models]].<ref name=":0" />

}}</ref>

== Honours and fellowship ==
In 1999, Mukhamedov received the Mathematics Prize of the Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Uzbekistan.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor (Full) at United Arab Emirates University |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Farrukh-Mukhamedov/8}}</ref> In 2005, he received the TWAS Prize for Young Scientists in Developing Countries.<ref name=":0" />

Mukhamedov is a corresponding fellow of the [[International Core Academy of Sciences and Humanities]] (CORE Academy).<ref name=":0" /> In 2022, He was elected a fellow of [[The World Academy of Sciences]] in the mathematical sciences section.<ref name="TWAS" /> He is also a fellow of the Industry Academy of the International Artificial Intelligence Industry Alliance.<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Farrukh Mukhamedov
 |url=https://www.aiia-ai.org/nd.jsp?id=1000&fromMid=3681&groupId=31
 |website=International Artificial Intelligence Industry Alliance
 |access-date=19 June 2026
}}</ref>
